arStrings.szText: "We risked worse in Hell. Let's do it."
Oh, I know. It was Donan who paid the price, then. But it worked. You stopped Lilith’s trail of carnage across our world. I’m ready to pay that price, too.
That’s if I can even figure out how to summon Astaroth in the first place. Elias’ notes here are incomplete. Could you look around?
